forms.name: Angelus Bush Blue
forms.dex: These colorful Pokémon are adapted to a variety of environments in order to act as a warning to potential predators, This particular form evolved from a Spewpa in the mysterious realm known as The End. The ethereal purples and of its wings reflect the eerie glow of the End's floating islands and otherworldly enviornment, this is a rumored variant among vivillonists, as few have ever ventured into The End to confirm its existence.

forms.name: Blue Moon
forms.dex: These colorful Pokémon are adapted to a variety of environments in order to act as a warning to potential predators, This particular form evolved from a Spewpa in the desolate islands of the End, where the watchful eyes of the Endermen keep a constant vigil. The Black and glowing purple hues of its wings mimic the towering appearance of the Endermen, allowing it to blend seamlessly into its surroundings. This form is unknown to many vivillonists, as many consider the End an enviornment too barren to host such a delicate creature.

Many vivillonists dream of encountering this rare form, as it is said to bring good fortune to those who do. But being in such a harsh environment, many of them only dream to encounter one.

forms.name: Red Sulphur
forms.dex: These colorful Pokémon are adapted to a variety of environments in order to act as a unique camouflage, This particular form evolved from a Spewpa in the depths of the Nether where the air is thick with sulfuric fumes that have given its wings a yellowish, fiery appearance. The bright yellows and orange hues of its wings mimic the fires that surround it. This is the most common form found in the nether, as many vivillonists have reported seeing them fluttering among the lava lakes and fiery landscapes of this asssaulting enviornment.

forms.name: Queen Flasher
forms.dex: These colorful Pokémon are adapted to a variety of environments in order to act as a warning to potential predators, This particular form evolved from a Spewpa in the Nether's Soul Sand Valleys, where the eerie blue flames dance among the desolate landscape. Its once vibrant colors have been replaced with ghostly blues and whites, allowing it to blend seamlessly into its haunting surroundings. This form is rarely seen by vivillonists, as few dare to venture into such a bleak and desolate enviornment in search of it.

forms.name: Geo Crystalfly
forms.dex: These colorful Pokémon are adapted to a variety of environments in order to act as a warning to potential predators, This particular form evolved from a Spewpa in a rocky dripstone cave deep underground, where the ceiling is encased in hardened mineral deposits. The golden hues of its wings mimic the color of the surrounding minerals one may find in this enviornment, allowing it to stand out against the dark cave walls. This form is highly sought after by collectors and researchers alike, as it represents a unique adaptation to its subterranean habitat.

forms.name: Prismatic
forms.dex: These colorful Pokémon are adapted to a variety of environments in order to act as a warning to potential predators, This particular form evolved from a Spewpa in the harsh nether enviornment known as the Warped Forest, where the air is thick with magical energy that has caused its wings to take a shimmering, almost blinding appearance. The prismatic colors of its wings reflect the hues of the warped flora and fauna found in this otherworldly realm, making it a truly unique sight to behold among vivillonists, yet on rare occurences the bright appearance is known to permanently effect the viewers vision.

forms.name: Hellfire
forms.dex: These colorful Pokémon are adapted to a variety of environments in order to act as a unique camouflage, This particular form evolved from a Spewpa in the fiery depths of the Nether in the Crimson Forest, Where the intense, smoldering heat has caused its wings to take on a fiery, almost hellish appearance. The blazing reds and oranges of its wings mimic the embers that surround it. This form is still quite unknown to vivillonists, as few dare to venture into such a dangerous environment in search of it.

forms.name: Iridescense
forms.dex: These colorful Pokémon are adapted to a variety of environments in order to act as a warning to potential predators, This particular form evolved from a rare subspecies of Vivillon known as Vivillon iridiscens. This endangered subspecies is known for its iridescent colorful wings that are rumored to shimmer with an otherworldly light at nightfall. The rainbow pattern on its wings is said to be a result of a unique genetic mutation that has been passed down through generations of this rare subspecies. Said mutation has also resulted it to carry attributes normally only seen in fairy type pokemon and an increased durability.

forms.name: Starlit
forms.dex: This rare variant of Vivillon is said to be blessed by the stars themselves, causing its wings to glisten with a stellar shine.
